content: Cloudflare Workers node:dns: dns.promises.resolve4/resolve6 work via DoH to 1.1.1.1 but dns.lookup/lookupService/resolve throw Not implemented. Each DNS query counts as a subrequest (50 free/1000 paid tier limit). Undici connect.lookup is NOT available on Workers; SSRF IP validation must use dns.promises.resolve4+resolve6 then deny-list check. True DNS pinning (connect to literal resolved IP) is not possible via standard fetch(); Workers fetch() does its own internal DNS resolution. The cf.resolveOverride option is the Cloudflare-specific DNS-pinning mechanism (needs spike verification).
